notes: Only the five specifically named trees inspected; no full worktree scan or Git mutation.
All non-evidence files/source/tests/fixtures/rules/plans/dependencies and all ignored/untracked files remain materialized.
Whole own evidence, d04, executable evidence directories, experiment input/marker roots retained. Non-identical or non-main blobs retained.
Logical/4K-rounded candidate sizes are not a claim of physical recovery. Operator must recheck fresh state before each change.

externalRuntimePathSearch.scope: Fixed current-main tracked executable/config files excluding evidence/plans; exact five WT absolute path prefixes
externalRuntimePathSearch.limit: Static known tracked references plus fresh open files/processes; not a proof against arbitrary future external dynamic path inputs.

remoteVerification.method: git ls-remote origin exact five refs (informational only)

eligibilityPolicy: Historical candidate file must have identical blob/mode in fixed worktree HEAD and fixed currently-advertised origin/main, plus identical materialized current bytes. Feature remote branch may be absent because own evidence/branch/objects remain; absence alone is informational. Released/clean/delivered/no active consumers and complete retention rules remain mandatory.

supersedes.reason: Lead corrected an extra feature-remote-branch prerequisite; original observations preserved, no push or branch operation.
